THE PATH TO UNION

Our Journey

October 2024

A Chance Encounter

Our story began with a formal introduction through mutual family relations during the festive season of Diwali. What started as a respectful family gathering blossomed into an engaging dialogue, revealing deep alignments in our personal values, life outlooks, and respect for tradition.

December 2024

The Alignment of Hearts

With the warm blessings of our parents, we spent time understanding each other's aspirations. A quiet afternoon walk along the historic vistas of South Mumbai cemented our mutual respect and the joyous realization that we wished to walk the path of life together.

September 2025

The Auspicious Betrothal

Surrounded by our close families in the heritage city of Udaipur, our commitment was formally sealed with the traditional Ring Ceremony. Under the glowing sunset of Rajasthan, we pledged our futures to one another in anticipation of our holy matrimony.
